Hosted by Erik Lindqvist New episodes on the first of the month Spotify Apple Podcasts RSS feed Making records slowly Sofia Marchetti designs about six record sleeves a year. We talk about saying no, paper stock and why she still sketches every cover by hand. Sofia Marchetti, sleeve designer Episode 4, 42 min 1 October 2026 A label run from a kitchen table Henrik Aalto has released forty records from his flat in Helsinki. He explains how a label stays small on purpose. Henrik Aalto, label founder Episode 3, 38 min 27 August 2026 Sound for small rooms Pablo Iriarte tunes bars, cinemas and listening rooms across Spain. A conversation about how a room sounds before anyone plays a note.
